name: AR-10 Identify customer by VIN and MSISDN

parameters.content:
## AR-10 Identify customer
Identity is plumbed from the UUI, never from speech. The model never sees the VIN or the phone number.

parameters.jsCode:
const r = $json;
return [{ json: { ok: true, known: !!r.found, customerRef: r.customerRef || '', vehicleRef: r.vin || '', greetingName: r.greetingName || '', vehicleLabel: r.vehicleLabel || '', preferredDealerId: r.preferredDealerId || '', preferredDealerName: r.preferredDealerName || '', market: r.market || '', language: r.language || '' } }];

meta.description: Looks the caller up in CRM / Customer 360 from the UUI identifiers. Inputs: vin, msisdn, correlationId. Returns {ok, known, customerRef, greetingName, vehicleLabel, preferredDealerId, preferredDealerName, market, language}. Called by AR-01, never by the model.
